fields.Text Field50: Environmental Monitoring Summary: Personnel sampling plates for analyst Varsha Subramanian and Settling sampling plates for ISO 5 BSC 1309, for the previous date, date of, and following date of testing showed no microbial growth. However, the surface  sampling plate for ISO 5 BSC 1309 exhibited 10 CFUs on surface# 1 plate  for the day of testing performed by analyst Varsha Subramanian, which were identified as Staphylococcus epidermidis (Gram (+) cocci) and Staphylococcus capitis (Gram (+) cocci). However, it is to be noted that the analyst reported that the Surface #1 plate was inadvertently dropped and opened, prior to incubation, which may have contributed to the microbial growth observed on the plate. No growth was observed on the plates sampled from the other three surfaces. Similarly, 10 CFUs on surface# 4 of BSC 1309 were observed for the following day of testing performed by analyst Halaina Smith, which were identified as Staphylococcus epidermidis (Gram (+) cocci) and Staphylococcus hominis (Gram (+) cocci). However, no growth was observed on the surface sampling plates for the previous date of testing. Additionally, no growth was observed on the weekly Active Air Sampling and the weekly surface sampling for Anteroom & Buffer room for CR117 for the week of testing. During the interview, the analyst Varsha Subramanian indicated that no obvious abnormalities or deviations from the testing procedure were observed. All samples were thoroughly disinfected prior to testing. In addition, the ISO 7 Cleanroom (CR 117A) and the ISO 5 Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC 1309) located within ISO 7 CR 117A were cleaned and prepared prior to test initiation in accordance with SOP 2.600.002, Environmental Monitoring of the Clean Room Facility, and SOP 2.600.018, Cleaning and Disinfecting Procedure for Microbiology.  Monthly cleaning and disinfection of the outermost ISO 8 Anteroom (Suite 117), the middle ISO 7 Buffer room (Suite 117A), the innermost ISO 7 clean room (Suite 117B), and its containing ISO 5 Biosafety Cabinets were performed on 22 Feb 2026 as per SOP 2.600.018 (Cleaning and Disinfecting Procedure for Microbiology) by analyst Tamiru Kotisso and Rey Estrada. It was documented that all H₂O₂ indicators passed. This confirms the efficient monthly cleaning of all three suites 117, 117A, and 117B. Additionally, cleaning and disinfecting was performed both prior to and after the testing process as per SOP 2.600.018. It is important to note that no samples processed by analyst Varsha Subramanian in ISO 5 BSC 1309 on 27 Feb 2026, failed ScanRDI testing.
fields.Text Field51: Based on the findings outlined in the preceding sections, the Out-Of-Specification (OOS) result observed for the Environmental Monitoring (EM) Surface Sampling plate may be attributed to a potential analyst error. No growth was observed on the other three surface sampling plates for the ISO 5 BSC for that day of testing. Additionally, no growth was observed on the settling and personnel sampling plates for the BSC for the date of and following date of testing, suggesting that the contamination originating from the analyst was transient in nature and daily routine disinfection procedures were effective in eliminating the contamination. Additionally, although growth was observed on the surface plate on the date of testing, inadvertent opening of the plate prior to incubation by the analyst, might have contributed to the positive EM result. Moreover, since no recurring trend of contamination was observed in the analyst’s historical EM data recently, no corrective action was deemed necessary at this point.
